title: Selected work.
description: Applied builds across banking operations, enterprise-adjacent tooling, and analytics.

CFB_Application.title: OD Recovery Rules Highlighter
CFB_Application.summary: Banking operations tool that applies NSF/OD recovery rules to account CSVs and exports a color-coded Excel workbook.
CFB_Application.outcome: Built during my Community First Bank practicum to replace manual sort-and-shade work for recovery teams.

NewsApplication.title: Brief — AI News Reader
NewsApplication.summary: Cross-platform mobile news app with a FastAPI backend that turns major RSS feeds into ~100-word AI summaries.
NewsApplication.outcome: Designed for faster daily reading with topic filters, bookmarks, and a cached summarization pipeline.

Stock-Index-Forecasting.title: Global Stock Index Forecasting
Stock-Index-Forecasting.summary: Purdue MGMT 590 final project forecasting monthly closing prices for major indices across India, USA, China, and Japan.
Stock-Index-Forecasting.outcome: End-to-end analytics workflow covering data prep, modeling, and executive-ready presentation of forecast results.
